answer_1.quote: We construct an "attacker" LLM that leverages the KGs to produce adversarial prompts. For the purposes of this study, the attacker LLM creates instructions for a tweet. ... Attacks can be adapted to other forms of content creation.
answer_1.outputs: viral tweets (and news headlines in ablation)

answer_2.quote: An attack is considered successful if it attains a score of 4 or higher... We report Attack Success Rates (ASRs) across models and languages.

answer_3.quote: We evaluated the harmfulness of attacks with the "Judge" LLM implemented with GPT-4o. The Judge applies a 5-point scale... An attack is successful if it attains a score of 4 or higher.

answer_4.quote: We manually validated LLM Judge scores for 10% of the generated outputs (n=200). The samples were split among four human coders... The coders evaluated generated outputs using the same criteria as the Judge LLM following the coding guides provided.
answer_4.guideline: Coding guides with policy review, rubric (scores 1-5), and examples were used for human annotation.
